result.summary: Found 1 visually broken issue: a restaurant image appears to be missing or failed to load in the “Popular right now” section.

issues.description: The hero image for “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” is shown as a gray placeholder with a broken/missing image icon, while the rest of the restaurant card content is loaded.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant image URL is valid and loads correctly. If the image is unavailable, use a polished fallback image instead of a broken placeholder icon.
